steps.en: OCMS receives the court's decision for a guilty-plea case
steps.id: OCMS menerima keputusan pengadilan untuk kasus yang terdakwanya mengaku bersalah
steps.why_en: No receiver exists for court decisions; only a generic update from another system is present.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada penerima keputusan pengadilan; yang ada hanya update umum dari sistem lain.

steps.en: The notice's processing stage is changed to match the outcome
steps.id: Tahap pemrosesan notice diubah sesuai hasil
steps.why_en: The stage can be overwritten from another system, but it is not worked out from the court decision.
steps.why_id: Tahap bisa ditimpa dari sistem lain, tetapi tidak ditentukan dari keputusan pengadilan.

steps.en: The mention outcome is saved on the notice
steps.id: Hasil sidang (mention outcome) disimpan di notice
steps.why_en: No place exists to save the mention outcome; only a screen definition is present.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada tempat menyimpan hasil sidang; yang ada hanya definisi tampilan.

steps.en: The default sentence and imposed court fine are saved
steps.id: Hukuman pengganti dan denda pengadilan yang dijatuhkan disimpan
steps.why_en: Neither the default sentence nor the court fine amount has any place to be saved.
steps.why_id: Hukuman pengganti maupun jumlah denda pengadilan tidak punya tempat penyimpanan.

steps.en: Instalment plan details are saved when there is a plan
steps.id: Detail cicilan disimpan bila ada rencana cicilan
steps.why_en: No place exists to save instalment plans.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada tempat menyimpan rencana cicilan.

steps.en: The officer can view these details on a notice screen
steps.id: Petugas bisa melihat detail ini di layar notice
steps.why_en: The court-details tab is switched off and the data behind it does not exist.
steps.why_id: Tab detail pengadilan dimatikan dan datanya tidak ada.
